definitions.gloss: stress eating; binge eating out of frustration or desperation
definitions.explanation: eating excessively as a way to cope with stress, frustration, or negative emotions

examples.japanese: ⟦ストレス→ストレス：03827_sutoresu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧やけ{食|ぐ}い⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧しまった。
⟦{失恋|しつれん}→失恋：04195_shitsuren⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧やけ{食|ぐ}い⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{走|はし}った→走る：00519_hashiru⟧。
examples.english: I turned to binge eating after a breakup.

examples.japanese: やけ{食|ぐ}い⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一時的|いちじてき}→一時的：05846_ichijiteki⟧な{解消法|かいしょうほう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧しか⟦ならない→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Stress eating is only a temporary solution.

notes:
やけ{食|ぐ}い refers to eating excessively as a way to cope with stress, frustration, or negative emotions.

ETYMOLOGY:
⟦やけ→やけ：29292_yake⟧ (desperation, recklessness from frustration) + {食|く}い (eating). The ⟦やけ→やけ：29292_yake⟧ comes from {自棄|やけ} (desperation, giving up).

USAGE:
- やけ{食|ぐ}い⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to stress-eat, to binge eat
- やけ{食|ぐ}い⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{走|はし}る→走る：00519_hashiru⟧: to turn to stress eating

RELATED WORDS:
- やけ{酒|ざけ}: drinking out of frustration
- ⟦やけ→やけ：29292_yake⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to become desperate/reckless
- ⟦{過食|かしょく}→過食：19288_kashoku⟧: overeating (medical/neutral term)
- ⟦{暴飲暴食|ぼういんぼうしょく}→暴飲暴食：08061_bouinboushoku⟧: binge eating and drinking

REGISTER:
Informal, colloquial. Often used self-deprecatingly to describe one's own behavior.
